title: Ellaz turn unit file
description: What a unit of a turn battle IS: its side, its hp and attack, how many tiles it walks in a turn, how far it strikes, and where its hp bar sits. Its picture is the sprite set's manifest; a turn unit needs no moves file - it has no hitboxes, a strike is a rule. `hover` REQUIRES `flying`; the validator subset has no if/then, so data.test.ts asserts it.

sprites.description: a directory under ../assets/ holding <set>.manifest.json with the five clips idle, walk, attack, hurt, ko

team.description: 0 is the party the player commands

name.description: as the panel and the log print it

atk.description: damage per strike; the target's hp floors at 0

move.description: tiles per turn, manhattan, through allies and never through foes

tall.description: view px above the feet where the hp bar and the damage float sit
